name: lokal-mcp
display_name: Rett fra Bonden — Finn lokal mat i Norge
description: Find local food producers in Norway. Search for farms, markets and shops by name, category or location. Get contact info and add producers to your contacts with one click.
long_description:
Rett fra Bonden connects you to 1,405+ local food producers across Norway. Search by natural language in Norwegian or English, filter by category (vegetables, honey, dairy, meat, fish, bread), discover farms near you, and get full contact details including opening hours, payment methods, and delivery options. Every result includes a vCard link so you can add the producer to your phone contacts instantly.

Examples:
- "Hvor finner jeg fersk honning i Oslo?"
- "organic vegetables near Grunerloekka"
- "ost Trondheim"
- "gaardsbutikker i Lofoten"

tools.name: lokal_search
tools.description: Search for local food producers in Norway using natural language. Supports Norwegian and English. Returns ranked producers with contact info and vCard links.

tools.name: lokal_discover
tools.description: Structured search by food category, tags, and geographic distance. Filter by vegetables, fruit, dairy, eggs, meat, fish, bread, honey, herbs.

tools.name: lokal_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific producer - address, products, opening hours, certifications, and a vCard contact link.

tools.name: lokal_stats
tools.description: Get Lokal platform statistics - total agents, cities covered, interactions.

tools.name: lokal_list_umbrellas
tools.description: List umbrella organizations on Lokal - market networks like Bondens marked, venues, industry organizations like Hanen, and certifiers like Debio. Optionally filter by type.

tools.name: lokal_get_umbrella_members
tools.description: List producers that belong to a specific umbrella organization's network, e.g. all farmers selling at Bondens marked or all Debio-certified producers.

tools.name: lokal_get_producer_affiliations
tools.description: List the umbrella organizations a specific producer belongs to - which markets they sell at, certifications they hold, or networks they're part of.

tools.name: lokal_bm_next_markets
tools.description: Get upcoming Bondens marked (farmers market) events for a region or a specific venue. Refreshed daily.

tools.name: lokal_geocode
tools.description: Resolve a Norwegian place name (city, region, or kommune) to lat/lng coordinates, for use with lokal_discover's distance filters.

tools.name: lokal_cart_create
tools.description: Writes data: creates a new anonymous shopping cart and returns a buyer capability token. First step of placing an order. No payment involved.

tools.name: lokal_cart_add_item
tools.description: Writes data: adds a product to an existing cart, or updates its quantity. Requires the cart ID and buyer token from lokal_cart_create.

tools.name: lokal_cart_view
tools.description: View the current contents and subtotal of a shopping cart. Read-only.

tools.name: lokal_cart_submit
tools.description: Writes data: submits the cart to place pickup orders, one per producer. No payment is charged. Sellers who opted in to notifications are emailed and can confirm or decline the order.

tools.name: lokal_order_status
tools.description: Check the status and timeline (pending/confirmed/ready/completed) of an order placed via lokal_cart_submit. Read-only.
